claims.text: Germany beat Brazil 7-1 in the semi-final of the 2014 men's World Cup.
The 2014 semi-final between Brazil and Germany did not end 3-0, 4-2 or 5-1.
Germany led Brazil 5-0 after 29 minutes, with goals in the 11th, 23rd, 24th, 26th and 29th minutes, at the Estádio Mineirão in Belo Horizonte.
Germany beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the 2014 final on 13 July, five days after the semi-final on 8 July.
